Blocks mined during leap day (February 29) in Bitcoin history, since the genesis (January 3, 2009). The first leap day was February 29, 2012: 179 blocks were mined, from 168,957 to 169,135. The second was February 29, 2016: 133 blocks were mined, from 400,468 to 400,600. The third was February 29, 2020: 139 blocks were mined, from 619,443 to 619,581. The fourth was February 29, 2024: 133 blocks were mined, from 832,470 to 832,602. In total there are 4 leap days and 584 blocks. The next leap day will be February 29, 2028, which is not included because its blocks have not been mined yet.
